id: title:Gilbert09:add featurebase survey and category tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion configuration and metadata for three new resource types (ticket_categories, surveys, survey_responses) and their parent-child relationships, enabling PostHog to ingest this specific customer data alongside existing warehouse resources.
review.reason: The observed changes add three new resource definitions and their corresponding ingestion configurations, including pagination and parent-child fan-out settings. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it extends PostHog's warehouse ingestion support to include these specific resources and their relationships. The implementation includes the necessary schema,
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of configuration and metadata additions, but the actual benefit depends on whether these resources are actively used by PostHog customers and whether the ingestion is successfully established. No evidence of actual adoption, incident avoidance, or performance improvement is present in the code or observations.
